entities.name: Co-Cathedral of the Assumption, Chilapa
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Co-Cathedral of the Assumption, also known as Chilapa Cathedral, is the main Catholic church in the city of Chilapa in the state of Guerrero, Mexico, and the second in the Diocese of Chilpancingo-Chilapa. It is dedicated to the Virgin of the Assumption.
